report_name: Multiple Threat Groups Claim Data Breaches Across Diverse Sectors

threat_actors.name: ExfilSquad
threat_actors.description: Claimed responsibility for data breaches against Allstate, Analog Devices, and Bonava as part of a wave of attacks reported by BreachSense on July 27, 2026.

threat_actors.name: TheGentlemen
threat_actors.description: Attributed with an attack on the Mexican publishing company Advance Marketing.

threat_actors.name: M3RX
threat_actors.description: Linked to a data breach at AusProof, an Australian electrical equipment manufacturer.

threat_actors.name: GlobalSecretGroup
threat_actors.description: Claimed responsibility for attacks on the Spanish cloud host Acens and a beverage company named Al Hayat.

threat_actors.name: BravoX
threat_actors.description: Implicated in an attack on A&A Safety, Inc., a U.S. highway construction firm.

threat_actors.name: SECUROTROP
threat_actors.description: Claimed a data breach against Advantage Sintered Metals.

threat_actors.name: ArcusMedia
threat_actors.description: Attributed with an attack on Brazeringenierie, a telecommunications firm.

threat_actors.name: TripleX
threat_actors.description: Claimed a data breach against the Bank of Baroda in India.

attack_patterns.name: Remote System Discovery
attack_patterns.description: Described as a characteristic discovery technique used by data theft groups to map internal networks.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: Described as a characteristic collection technique used by data theft groups to gather sensitive data from file shares and databases.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Described as a characteristic exfiltration method used by data theft groups.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: Referenced as a technique to be monitored, associated with tools like Mimikatz for credential theft.

attack_patterns.name: Archive Collected Data
attack_patterns.description: Referenced as a data staging technique to be monitored, involving the use of archiving tools to package data for exfiltration.

indicators.name: Data Exfiltration Tool Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Data Exfiltration Tool Execution
id: 9b1d8c7e-f6a5-4b3c-8d2a-1e9f0b8c7d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of common data transfer tools like rclone, megacmd, or filezilla, which can be used for data exfiltration.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-27
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\megacmd.exe'
      - '\filezilla.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of common data transfer tools mentioned as hunting hints for data theft operations.

indicators.name: Password-Protected Archive Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Password-Protected Archive Creation for Staging
id: a2c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 7-Zip to create a password-protected archive, a common TTP for staging data for exfiltration.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-27
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
tags:
  - attack.t1560
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\7z.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - ' a '
      - ' -p'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of 7-Zip with a password switch, a technique mentioned for staging data.
